# robots.txt - Arianation SEO Configuration
# Last Updated: May 2026

# Default rules for all bots
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /products/
Allow: /products/*
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /dashboard/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /*.json$
Disallow: /?*
Disallow: /*?*sort=
Disallow: /*?*filter=
Disallow: /checkout/
Disallow: /cart/
Crawl-delay: 1
Request-rate: 30/60

# Google-specific
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Allow: /admin/robots.txt
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /dashboard/
Crawl-delay: 0

# Bing-specific
User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /dashboard/
Crawl-delay: 1

# Block bad bots
User-agent: MJ12bot
User-agent: AhrefsBot
User-agent: SemrushBot
Disallow: /

# Sitemap reference
Sitemap: https://arianation.com/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://arianation.com/sitemap-products.xml
